source_note: Chinese hot-topic candidates are collected from public trend pages; English wording is matched to supplied official English headlines when possible, otherwise suggested neutrally.

topics.chinese_topic: 比什凯克再聚首 共赴上合新征程
topics.official_english: SCO Leaders Meet Again in Bishkek for a New Chapter
topics.why_hot: It marks another major diplomatic gathering, with regional cooperation and China's role in the Shanghai Cooperation Organization drawing wide attention.
topics.share_angle: Explain what the SCO is, why Bishkek matters, and what a 'new journey' could mean for member states.

topics.chinese_topic: 温州多地紧急通知：停课一天
topics.official_english: Wenzhou Issues Emergency One-Day Class Suspensions in Multiple Areas
topics.why_hot: An abrupt one-day school suspension directly affects families and prompts questions about safety and contingency planning.
topics.share_angle: Break down how Chinese cities announce emergency school closures and what it means for parents and students.

topics.chinese_topic: 这届学生的名字都很个性
topics.official_english: This Generation of Students Has Very Distinctive Names
topics.why_hot: A viral discussion about students' highly individual names taps into Chinese naming culture, generational identity and family expectations.
topics.share_angle: Use real-name trends to explain how Chinese parents choose names and how characters can carry cultural weight.

topics.chinese_topic: 中国运载火箭为啥叫长征
topics.official_english: Why Is China's Launch Vehicle Called the Long March?
topics.why_hot: It connects aerospace engineering with a famous chapter of Chinese revolutionary history, and many people are learning the origin story for the first time.
topics.share_angle: Tell the story behind the Long March rocket name and what it symbolizes in China's space program.

topics.chinese_topic: 吉隆口岸核心区救援通道已抢通
topics.official_english: Rescue Passage Opened in Core Area of Gyirong Port
topics.why_hot: Rescue access in the Gyirong Port area is seen as vital progress amid ongoing disaster response, and the public is following updates closely.
topics.share_angle: Explain where Gyirong Port is, why the rescue passage matters, and how emergency access is being restored.

topics.chinese_topic: 网红村支书因女儿重度抑郁决定辞职
topics.official_english: Village Party Secretary Resigns Over Daughter's Severe Depression
topics.why_hot: A viral village official's resignation puts a personal face on severe depression and ignites conversations about mental health, parenting and public roles.
topics.share_angle: Frame it as a conversation starter about mental health awareness and the pressures faced by parents in public life.

topics.chinese_topic: 全国小学初中已全部替换新教材
topics.official_english: New Textbooks Fully Rolled Out Across Primary and Junior High Schools Nationwide
topics.why_hot: The full switch to new textbooks affects millions of students and teachers at the start of the school year, making education policy a household subject.
topics.share_angle: Highlight what the new textbook rollout means for students and how curriculum updates reflect broader educational goals.

topics.official_english: Pien Tze Huang, Known as 'Medicine Moutai,' Falls From Pedestal
topics.why_hot: The fall of a once-iconic traditional Chinese medicine brand, called the 'Moutai of medicines,' sparks discussion about its products, pricing and reputation.
topics.share_angle: Introduce Pien Tze Huang's status in China and what its decline reveals about the traditional Chinese medicine industry.
